description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The California Institute of Technology Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) hires an Engineering Applications Software Engineer to provide software engineering and operational support to NASA/JPL flight and R&D project customers. The role develops and operates engineering, data management, visualization, and GenAI applications across the flight mission lifecycle, including support for flight computer hardware integration.
Engineering Applications Software Engineer Level 1 developing flight-mission data systems, AWS GenAI telemetry pipelines, and visualization applications

Responsibilities:
• The qualified candidate will be a member of the Advanced Information Analysis and Visualization Group (341C) in JPL's Artificial Intelligence and Data Science section, reporting to the Group Supervisor, and will provide software engineering and operational support to NASA/JPL Flight and R&D project customers
• Designs, develops, and/or modifies engineering applications for highly complex or specialized capabilities within spacecraft, instrument/sensor, telecommunications, control systems, electronic ground support equipment (egse), navigation, planning, or similar data and mission software systems. Utilizes extensive domain-specific engineering expertise to understand the needs of the customer, translate needs into requirements, develop prototype applications, iterate with customers and then deliver quality applications. Involved in entire life-cycle of system, including planning, development, deployment and maintenance. Responsible for understanding and meeting software operational and engineering requirements
• Provide software development, operational and customer support for flight mission and R&D project customers using on premise and cloud-hosted data management systems
• Meet with project task leads to design, develop, maintain and operate data management, GenAI and data visualization software systems
• Support high-performance flight computer hardware integration with commercial GPUs
• Develop new or port existing algorithms and software onto high-performance flight computer systems
• Knowledge of electrical integration to support flight hardware and testbeds
• Design and develop 3D and 2D data visualization and dashboard software as well as UI/UX interfaces to support mission ground systems and Digital Twin development
• Design, develop and deploy web and cloud-centric software applications for the entire flight mission life-cycle, from formulation through launch and operations
• Be responsible for the design and development of AWS GenAI pipelines used for analysis and visualization of very large flight mission telemetry data sets
• Develop and deliver hardware and software documentation, such as requirements and design documents, and operational procedures
• Ensure compliance with applicable Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations

Requirements:
• Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math or related discipline with a minimum of 1 year of related experience or Master's degree with 0 years of experience
• Knowledge of modern software development tools and practices (GitHub, Visual Studio Code, continuous integration, automated software testing, Agile methodology, etc.)
• Excellent applied math skills including Linear Algebra
• Excellent software engineering skills and algorithm development, with strong system debugging and problem-solving skills
• Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
• Full stack web and legacy language application development experience
• Demonstrated experience developing GenAI pipelines on-premise and AWS-hosted using Parquet, Athena, Claude, Bedrock
• Proven decision-making and problem-solving skills in a complex and dynamic work environment, including the ability to perform highly complex analysis and assessments
• Proficiency in C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, WebGL, React, MaterialUI, Angular
• Experience designing and developing user-facing web and desktop UI/UX software
• Knowledge of modern Information Data Management tools, architectures and best practices, including modern relational and time-series database solutions
• Knowledge and experience with modern data science/data analytics tools and techniques, including GenAI/ML/LLM
• Strong commitment to customer satisfaction with effective broad-based teamwork skills
• Proven ability to establish task priorities and manage change as flight project data management needs evolve over time
• Proven ability to resolve highly complex and/or technical mission control system issues
• Practical knowledge and use of DevOps practices and tools, including continuous integration and containerization
• The Jet Propulsion Laboratory is a federal facility. Due to rules imposed by NASA, JPL will not accept applications from citizens of designated countries or those born in a designated country unless they are U.S. Citizens, Legal Permanent Residents of the U.S or have other protected status under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)
